eyebrow: SQL Server Performance Tuning · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 10 · Understanding Execution Plans Deeply

code:
SELECT cp.usecounts, cp.objtype, cp.size_in_bytes,
       st.text
FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans AS cp
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(cp.plan_handle) AS st
ORDER BY cp.size_in_bytes DESC;
caption: usecounts well above 1 is a healthy sign — the plan is being reused.
Thousands of usecounts=1 rows, differing only by a literal, is the signature.
